channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: TSE altera locais de votação e PT pede melhor divulgação sobre mudanças
item.description: The Brazil Ready for More coalition, led by PT with PCdoB and PV support, asked the TSE to inform each voter individually about changes to 4,352 voting locations. The move aims to ensure transparency and prevent confusion on election day. No other political parties were mentioned in the content.

item.title: PF investiga R$ 1,4 bi em transações entre amigo de Flávio e site de aposta
item.description: Federal Police are investigating 1.4 billion reais in transactions between lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, and the betting site Blaze, operated in Brazil by Foggo Entertainment.

item.title: 'Eleição no Brasil pode definir futuro da Amazônia', diz The New York Times; entenda posição do jornal
item.description: The New York Times article emphasizes that the Brazilian presidential election could determine the fate of the Amazon, with front-runner Flávio Bolsonaro advocating for opening protected areas to mining, agriculture and infrastructure, raising expert concerns over increased deforestation and risks to indigenous communities.

item.title: Quem Lula escalou para acompanhá-lo no debate da Band
item.description: President Lula is preparing for the Band debate with the support of allies like Governor Rafael Fonteles and former minister Rui Costa, focusing on the second-round electoral strategy.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem atos em São Paulo, Rio e Brasília; Flávio participa de evento na Paulista
item.description: Supporters of Lula and Flávio hold rallies in São Paulo, Rio, and Brasília one week before the runoff. Artists organize pro-Lula events, while Flávio Bolsonaro joins a Paulista Avenue gathering with officials and followers. The Electoral Court reviews lawsuits questioning the legality of artistic events.

item.title: Advogado disse a Vorcaro que ele tinha o “apoio do presidente”
item.description: Messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone show that lawyer Walfrido Warde claimed Globo was trying to weaken his support for President Lula and the PT through the Banco Master acquisition by BRB. Warde alleged that the media sought to undermine Vorcaro's political backing, tied to the president, during the deal approval process. The report received no comment from the Presidency's press office.

item.title: Ato de Flávio Bolsonaro na Paulista reúne 71,9 mil pessoas, estima USP
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign rally on Paulista Avenue gathered around 71,900 people at peak time, according to estimates by the USP/Cebrap Political Debate Monitor and More in Common. The event took place one week before the second round of the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro derramou dados e números fantasiosos em sabatina no JN
item.description: In a Jornal Nacional interview, Flávio Bolsonaro pledged to respect election results but pivoted to unverified claims about Lula-era records in violence, crime, and environmental issues—some of which also occurred or were worse under his father’s government. He advocated loosening gun laws and downplayed ammunition tracking, despite expert warnings about domestic risks. His statements were widely challenged by official data and fact-checkers.

item.title: Reta final do 2º turno: Lula aposta em medidas populares para virar, e Flávio quer reforçar que manterá programas sociais
item.description: In the final stretch of Brazil's 2026 presidential runoff, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro compete for votes through debates and street mobilization in the Southeast. Polls show a technical tie with Flávio slightly ahead. Lula relies on popular measures and opposes benefit cuts, while Flávio emphasizes proposals and social programs.

item.title: “Vocês verão Jair Bolsonaro colocar a faixa no filho”, diz Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro declared at a rally on Paulista Avenue that if elected, he will receive the presidential sash from his father, Jair Bolsonaro, while reinforcing the message of freeing Brazil from the PT a week before the runoff.

item.title: PM mobiliza equipes para atos pró-Flávio e pró-Lula simultâneos em SP
item.description: São Paulo police deployed teams to simultaneous pro-Flávio Bolsonaro and pro-Lula rallies on Avenida Paulista and Largo da Batata, reporting no incidents. Both groups received security, traffic, and mediation support to maintain public order.

item.title: Lula: campanha aciona TSE por transporte a quem teve local de votar mudado
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting free public transportation and direct communication to voters whose polling places were changed for the second round. Around 4,352 polling sections had their locations altered, affecting thousands of voters, especially in Rio de Janeiro. The measure aims to reduce voter abstention in the October 25 election.

item.title: Morte de jovem em ato pró-Lula em SE não teve motivação política, diz PT
item.description: The death of 14-year-old Jhonathan during the 'Arrastão de Lula' event in Propriá (SE) was clarified by the PT as stemming from personal conflicts, not political motives. The case involves a stabbing, with a suspect arrested. The party expressed condolences to the family and emphasized the need for a thorough investigation by authorities.

item.title: Pressionado a se posicionar, João Gomes diz ser “a favor da democracia”
item.description: At a concert in Londrina, João Gomes publicly voiced support for democracy without directly naming Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro, though the audience responded with the 'L' gesture. The artist discussed topics such as education, public healthcare, scientific research, and freedom of expression, avoiding explicit endorsement of any candidate.

item.title: Messias convoca integrantes do Exército do Lula para atos no RJ
item.description: Jorge Messias, Brazil's Attorney General, used the social media platform X to call on members of the WhatsApp group 'Army of Lula' to attend protests in Rio de Janeiro, mimicking a military mobilization order. The post reinforces Messias' expectation of a new appointment to the Supreme Federal Court, following his rejection by the Senate in April 2026.

item.title: A acusação de Manuela D’Ávila a candidato a vice-presidente da República
item.description: Manuela D'Ávila accused vice-presidential candidate Alfredo Gaspar of rape without presenting evidence, during an event in Porto Alegre. The Supreme Court had already closed an investigation into the case, finding no concrete evidence. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign announced legal action against Manuela, as the accusation circulates among Bolsonaro supporters and intensifies the electoral race.

item.title: Flávio promete receber faixa presidencial das mãos de Bolsonaro em ato na Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) promised to receive the presidential sash from his jailed father, Jair Bolsonaro, during a campaign rally on Paulista Avenue, while the former president remains under house arrest for coup-related crimes. The event, named 'Bloquinho 22', gathered right-wing leaders and supporters who criticized the PT and Lula. Flávio announced plans to accuse his opponent during the TV debate.

item.title: Bolsonaro reúne una marea amarilla para echar a Lula y emprender el cambio en Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro intensified his campaign with a large rally on Paulista Avenue, using yellow and green flag colors to mobilize supporters against the PT. With seven days left to the vote, he remains in a tight race with Lula, who led a similar demonstration days earlier.

item.title: Fátima Bernardes cita democracia e volta a declarar voto em Lula
item.description: Fátima Bernardes declared her vote for Lula and Alckmin, defending democracy, freedoms, social rights, and social policies for vulnerable populations. She criticized aggressive rhetoric against women and the LGBTQ+ community, warning about threats to national sovereignty. She reaffirmed that the vote does not break relationships with those who think differently.

item.title: Ato de Flávio ocupa 6 quarteirões da Paulista, 1 a menos que Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign rally on Paulista Avenue occupied 6 blocks, one fewer than Lula's event which spanned 7 blocks. Both rallies were documented, but aerial drone imagery of the PT rally was restricted by security protocols.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula se reúnem em Brasília em apoio ao presidente
item.description: Supporters of President Lula gathered at the Ministries Esplanade in Brasília for a PT-organized rally as part of the 'Bora Virar' initiative, aiming to mobilize undecided voters for the presidential runoff. The event also supported Leandro Grass, the PT candidate for DF governor, and required road closures due to the large turnout. Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are preparing to participate in a debate on Band TV that evening.

item.title: Fernanda Bolsonaro grava vídeo no mercado: “Preços estão um terror”
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro posted a video highlighting soaring supermarket prices to back her husband Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, framing inflation as a key issue. The couple criticized the cost-of-living crisis, using beef prices as an example (up from $62.99/kg in 2022 to $106.55/kg in 2026). The move aims to reinforce the PL's economic narrative and public discontent.

item.title: Flávio na Paulista: 'Vocês verão Jair Messias Bolsonaro colocando a faixa de presidente da República no filho dele'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro spoke on Paulista Avenue, promising to liberate Brazil from the PT and suggesting his father, Jair Bolsonaro, will place the presidential sash on him. He praised the former president and emphasized the country's dependence on God, reinforcing a message of unity and confrontation with the PT. The event featured support from PL allies and previewed a debate on Rede Bandeirantes.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai levar a debate relação de lobista com Lulinha, e Lula argumenta que não há contratos dela com o governo
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger claimed to have a close relationship with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and his son, but did not present concrete evidence of criminal involvement. Flávio Bolsonaro used social media to spread the allegations and said he would raise the issue in an upcoming debate, while the federal government denied any contract or contact with the lobbyist. The case emerges just before the 2026 presidential runoff, intensifying political polarization.

item.title: Veja imagens do ato da esquerda em Brasília neste domingo
item.description: Supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva gathered in front of the National Museum of the Republic on the Ministries Esplanade in Brasília on Sunday (October 18, 2026), demonstrating support for the government and criticizing political opponents, including caricatures of Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Roberta põe Lulinha como lobista de empresa do túnel de Santos
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger, under investigation by the Federal Police, revealed Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) as a lobbyist for the company involved in the Santos-Guarujá Tunnel project, a key initiative of Tarcísio de Freitas. The strained relationship between Roberta and Lulinha, tied to fraud allegations in the INSS and corruption schemes, sparked political debates and suspicions of undue influence in the project's bidding process.

item.title: O recorde de críticas a Lula nas redes após entrevista de Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger's interview on CNN Brasil triggered the highest spike of criticism against Lula on social media in 2026, with 37,587 negative mentions in one hour. The backlash included 14,833 references to the phrase 'Lula mentiroso' and increased negative mentions about Lulinha, the president's son. Luchsinger stated she intends to sign a plea bargain without sparing Lula or his son.

item.title: PT cobra TSE após mudanças em locais de votação
item.description: The PT requested that the TSE widely publicize changes to voting locations for the second round, affecting 2,033 electoral sections and approximately 592,000 voters. The coalition asked for greater transparency regarding these changes.

item.title: Quem está na frente para presidente no segundo turno? Veja resultado das últimas pesquisas com Lula e Flávio
item.description: One week before the 2026 runoff election, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 47% of voting intentions, compared to 44.8% for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), according to the Rali aggregator. The tool, developed by GLOBO and Instituto Locomotiva, compiles data from institutes such as Datafolha, Quaest, and Ipespe, along with government approval ratings.

item.title: PT aposta em atos descentralizados pela democracia com Emicida em SP e Caetano Veloso no Rio; Flávio Bolsonaro lota Avenida Paulista
item.description: The PT promotes decentralized rallies nationwide with support from artists like Emicida, Caetano Veloso, and Gilberto Gil to back Lula. Flávio Bolsonaro fills Paulista Avenue, while the Electoral Court reviews lawsuits questioning whether events are 'political concerts'. Lula has a limited schedule, with only a TV debate, as the campaign prioritizes organic and local mobilizations.

item.title: "O povo tá na rua defendendo direitos", diz Grass em ato da esquerda no DF
item.description: Leandro Grass (PT) participated in the 'Ato da Virada' at the Praça do Museu Nacional da República, in Brasília, a demonstration supporting Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) reelection in the 2026 elections. During the event, Grass emphasized popular mobilization in defense of social rights such as education, housing, and health, and stated that the Federal District has 'way, hope, and alternative'.

item.title: Estudantes retomam protagonismo em momento decisivo no país, diz UNE
item.description: Students take to the streets again to defend democracy, public education, and public universities, particularly with the second round of the presidential elections underway. The UNE highlights the risk of an authoritarian government and calls for improvements for low-income students.

item.title: A outra artista proibida de entrar no camarim de Lula durante a sabatina
item.description: Comedian Tatá Werneck and TV host Paulo Vieira were barred from visiting President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the Globo backstage during the October 15 town hall. The network cited concerns about maintaining impartiality as the reason. The incident was shared by Paulo Vieira on social media.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz ato na Paulista com Tarcísio e Nikolas
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) held a campaign rally on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo with governors Tarcísio de Freitas and Nikolas. During the event, he displayed a flag reading 'Out with Lula and Moraes,' criticizing President Lula and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Motorista avança carro em ato pró-Lula e atropela homem de 67 anos em MG
item.description: At a pro-Lula rally in Belo Horizonte, a 45-year-old driver rammed into protesters, seriously injuring a 67-year-old man. He fled the scene but was arrested on attempted homicide charges, claiming he acted in self-defense after being pelted with bottles and cans by demonstrators.

item.title: Filho de Temer aparece em vídeo com adesivo de apoio a Lula
item.description: Michel Temer's youngest son, 17, was filmed wearing a pro-Lula sticker, going against his father Michel Temer's public endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro. The video, recorded at Meretriz Bar in São Paulo, highlights growing political divergence within the Temer family.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro chega na Avenida Paulista e cumprimenta apoiadores em ato
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a rally on Paulista Avenue, where he criticized Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and confirmed his participation in the televised debate scheduled for the evening of October 18. He highlighted his father's legacy, Jair Bolsonaro, and mobilized supporters and party allies.

item.title: Veja imagens do ato de Flávio Bolsonaro na av. Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro held a campaign rally on Paulista Avenue in São Paulo, with support from Tarcísio de Freitas, Ricardo Nunes, and Nikolas Ferreira. Protesters displayed signs in English calling for freedom and amnesty, amid the 2026 electoral context.

item.title: Os gastos de Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula no universo digital
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) spent over 10 million reais on social media content promotion. The PL senator spent approximately 7.45 million, representing about 10% of the campaign's total expenses, while Lula invested 2.59 million, roughly 4% of his budget. The digital battle has intensified with initiatives like the 'Lula Army,' which mobilized over 4 million online supporters.

item.title: Com funk e axé, Flávio Bolsonaro transforma ato político em bloco de carnaval na Av. Paulista
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) held a campaign event on Paulista Avenue called 'Bloco do 22', using funk and axé music to mobilize supporters. The event featured sound trucks, fireworks, and appearances by political allies such as Nikolas Ferreira, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Ricardo Nunes. During the rally, supportive chants and criticism of Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes were recorded.

item.title: Bahia x Flamengo no Brasileirão: onde assistir, horário e escalações
item.description: Bahia and Flamengo face off this Sunday, the 18th, at 6:30 PM BRT, at Arena Fonte Nova, in the 31st round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship. The match will be broadcast on Premiere, with confirmed lineups featuring Jean Lucas, Rodrigo Nestor, and Alejo Véliz for Bahia, and Jorge Carrascal, Pedro, and Lucas Paquetá for Flamengo.

item.title: Wilson Pedroso na Crusoé: Fim da 6×1 ajuda, mas não basta para Lula
item.description: The approval of the constitutional amendment ending the 6×1 rule in the Senate, with 75 votes to 1, may help Lula, but is not enough on its own to decide the election. The measure, passed ten days before the runoff, is viewed as an electorally favorable agenda item, but insufficient to reverse the election outcome.

item.title: Campanha de Lula traz depoimento da mãe de Paulo Gustavo sobre a pandemia
item.description: Lula's campaign will emotionally leverage the testimony of Dona Déa, mother of Paulo Gustavo, to criticize Bolsonaro's management during the pandemic. The video will air on social media and during prime time on Tuesday, highlighting the actor's death in 2021 after nearly two months hospitalized from Covid-19 complications.

item.title: Local de votação muda em mais de 4 000 seções no 2º turno; saiba como consultar
item.description: The Electoral Justice changed the voting location for 4,352 sections in the second round of the 2026 Elections, representing 0.87% of the 499,248 sections. The changes were motivated by factors such as damage caused by rains, reforms and infrastructure problems. Voters should check the new address through the e-Título app or the Electoral Self-Service on the TSE portal.

item.title: “Bomba na família Lula”, diz Flávio após entrevista de Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) commented on social media about the accusations made by lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger against Lula (PT) and his son, calling them a 'bomb in the Lula family'. Following Luchsinger's interview on CNN Brasil, Flávio emphasized the phrases 'liar and bad character' to describe Lula.

item.title: Entenda como WhatsApp virou arma poderosa na campanha eleitoral
item.description: WhatsApp has become a central tool in Brazilian electoral campaigns, leveraging trust among close contacts to spread political content in family, work and friendship groups. Experts point out that messages shared by known people are more effective than institutional advertising, as they bypass the critical self-awareness typical of traditional media. This behavior amplifies the spread of information, often without prior verification, substantially influencing opinions and electoral decisions.

item.title: A privatização dos Correios no governo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Despite Flávio Bolsonaro's privatist profile, the postal service is unlikely to be privatized under his government, given the agency's dire financial situation. The decision depends on unresolved economic and political factors.

item.title: Congressistas acionam STF para pedir proteção a Roberta Luchsinger
item.description: Pro-government lawmakers filed a lawsuit at the STF requesting protection for lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and her daughters, after she expressed fear for her safety and accused Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The letter, co-signed by Marcel Van Hattem, Zucco, and Bia Kicis, calls for investigations into alleged threats and protective measures under the Maria da Penha Law. Luchsinger, investigated for suspected influence peddling, stated she plans to strike a plea deal and will not spare political figures.

item.title: 3 de 14 clubes protestam contra proibição de bets em camisas
item.description: Three Brazilian Série A clubs wore protest messages on their jerseys against the ban on betting advertising. The temporary measure still needs congressional approval and Supreme Court analysis, with a likely ruling after the 2026 elections.

item.title: Cotado a ministro, Sachsida já entregou pacote de 200 propostas econômicas a Flávio
item.description: Adolfo Sachsida, former minister under Jair Bolsonaro and a likely pick for a role in Flávio Bolsonaro's team if he wins the 2026 election, has already delivered a package of 200 economic proposals to the senator, focusing on microeconomics, sector deregulation, and legislative measures. The information was disclosed in an exclusive article for subscribers.
